analysis.reason_quote: The service was not medically necessary because conservative treatment was not documented for at least six weeks before imaging.
analysis.reason_plain: They say the scan was not needed because your file does not show six weeks of simpler treatment, like physiotherapy or medication, before the scan.
analysis.deadline_quote: Your appeal must be received within 180 days of the date of this letter.
analysis.appeal_channel: send a written request to Example Health Plan, Appeals Department, PO Box 0000, Example City, or call the number on your member card
evidence_needed: Doctor's notes showing the conservative treatment tried before the MRI and the dates
A letter of medical necessity from the ordering doctor
Physiotherapy or medication records from the six weeks before 2026-08-02
questions_to_ask: Which policy section defines the six-week conservative treatment requirement?
Did the reviewer have the referring doctor's notes?
Is a peer-to-peer review between my doctor and the plan's medical reviewer available?

analysis.reason_quote: The number of visits requested exceeds the plan limit of 8 visits per calendar year without a documented functional improvement report.
analysis.reason_plain: The plan covers 8 physiotherapy visits a year. To get more, they want a report from your therapist showing you are improving.
analysis.deadline_quote: You may file an appeal within 60 days of receiving this notice by submitting the appeal form on the member portal.
analysis.appeal_channel: submitting the appeal form on the member portal
evidence_needed: A functional improvement report from the physical therapist
The treatment plan showing why 12 visits are needed
questions_to_ask: What must a functional improvement report contain to satisfy the plan?
Can the first 8 visits be approved now while the rest is reviewed?
